question: As of March 2022, the common High Court for the states of Punjab and Haryana is located at _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandigarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** High Court **of **Punjab and Haryana** was established on **20th April 1955, **and it started functioning in** Chandigarh** from **17th August 1955.**
 
• This High Court has** 85 sanctioned judges**,** 64** of them are **Permanent Judges** and** 21 Additional Judges,** including the Chief Justice.
 
• Chandigarh is a **Union Territory** and serves as the capital of both Punjab and Haryana, and hence it was chosen as the location for the common High Court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Indian High Courts **are the highest courts with **appellate authority** over all Indian states and union territories.

 
 
• Most high courts handle **writ petitions** in accordance with **Articles 226 and 227** of the constitution, as well as appeals from subordinate courts.
 
• Another original jurisdiction of a high court is** writ jurisdiction.**
 
• Every state has judicial districts that are governed by** district and sessions judges.**
 
• All Indian courts, including high courts, are constrained by the decisions and directives of the Supreme Court of India by precedence under **Article 141** of the constitution.
 
 
 
• **Firozpur** is a city in** Punjab** and has a district court.
 
• **Karnal** is a city in **Haryana** and has a district court.
 
• **Faridabad** is a city in** Haryana** and has a district court.
